analyst_view.overall: Early view: Bayern should have more of their injured players back by early December, with Jamal Musiala and Luis Díaz both expected to return after the break, though Serge Gnabry is out for the rest of the year and one injury tracker lists Manuel Neuer out until January. Paderborn have conceded only 11 in nine games, one of the better records in the league, and goalkeeper Nahuel Noll has been in good form.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals. I lean slightly higher: Bayern have scored 29 in nine, including seven against Union and six against Leipzig, and with Musiala and Díaz back their attack should be deeper. Paderborn defend well, but rarely face this level of pressure.

corners.text: The site expects 11.6 corners. Paderborn defend with a back five and Bayern will have most of the ball, so I lean slightly higher; in that kind of game Bayern's corners pile up from blocked crosses and shots.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.6 cards. Paderborn have been booked regularly (three at Gladbach, plus coach Ralf Kettemann against Frankfurt), and teams chasing Bayern's passing commit tactical fouls, so I lean a little higher.

shots.text: The site has 36.8 shots, 27.2 for Bayern. That Bayern figure is well above their season rate of about 23 per game, so even against a deep side I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.6 on target, ten of them Bayern's. Paderborn block a lot of shots with five defenders in a crowded box, so I lean slightly lower, though Bayern should still dominate this count.
